claims.sentence: Your curriculum can include parts from programs of different types, levels, and directions
You can study the full program or individual subjects, courses, modules, practice, or other components using the resources of multiple organizations, including foreign ones
The program may cover competencies from one or several professions, specialties, or training directions, and may allow you to obtain multiple qualifications simultaneously
When you are admitted to a network program, you are enrolled in the base organization
You remain a student of the base organization throughout your studies
If you study a part of the program at a participating organization, you are transferred to that organization without being dismissed from the base organization
During that period, you are also a student of the participating organization
You are not enrolled in an organization that possesses resources
You study the assigned part of the program at the participating organization according to the forms and order set by that organization's local rules
The participating organization determines the specific procedures for your study period
After you fully complete that part of the program at the participating organization, you are dismissed from it

If the program requires joint final certification by both the base and participating organizations, your dismissal from the participating organization happens only after that certification is completed
Your study period at the participating organization includes current control and intermediate certification
These assessments follow the forms defined in the network program's curriculum and the order established by the participating organization
If the University acts as the participating organization, the assessments follow the University's local regulations

The results of your intermediate certification at the participating organization count as your official results for the network program and do not require additional verification at the base organization
If you successfully complete the network program and pass the final certification, the base organization issues you education and/or qualification documents
If the Network Form Agreement specifies it, you also receive education and/or qualification documents from the participating organization
For programs that do not include final certification, documents are issued according to the conditions and order set in the Network Form Agreement
The evidence does not specify which partner institutions are available or how many students can be transferred to them
It does not state the duration of study periods at participating organizations or the deadlines for transfers
The evidence does not define what happens if you fail current control or intermediate certification at a participating organization
It does not explain how joint final certification is organized or what happens if you do not pass it
The evidence does not list the specific types of documents issued by participating organizations or the exact conditions for receiving them
The evidence does not provide course pages, so course-specific variations are not covered
